title: How to make Codex & Claude talk together explained
author: M1ghtyMe
selftext:
Hey, I just wanted to make a post about the setup of my game. 

Tonight I decided to add Codex in my workflow after hearing so many positive things and being underwhelmed by Opus 5 lately. 

i am building a 3d 1v1 first person shooter, inspired by quake, tf2 and counter strike. 

so far the game is working, ive got multiplayer even set up and a big plan to keep working on. 

  
anyway i saw in another post someone was asking someone in the comments how they connected Claude and Codex. 

  
So basically in my project I was tired of copy pasting messages from Claude agent to agent, and I had Fable build a whole messaging system, called "the bus"

basically agents can send messages to each other. and upon creation of a new agent or if i say "check ur inbox" the agents speak to each other. 

Combine this with scheduled tasks and a night run loops quite nicely. 

  
The good part is that its in my file explorer located in the dev folder, and now Codex can also write there.

So pretty cool now they are both talking to eachother if needed. 

  
I do have to say, so far pretty underwhelmed by Astra. My biggest time loss / pain point at this stage is the asset creation and pipeline from idea/visual/in game correct way. 

astra couldnt do it yet at all but its doing a night loop now lets see. first 2 tries pretty poor, can share more if interested
